note: WAEC Commerce round 6 (R29 top-up): merger vs takeover, franchise, chain and departmental stores, mail order, itinerant traders, supermarket self-service; hire purchase ownership on last instalment, credit cards, documents against acceptance, sight draft; voyage charter, freight forwarder, clearing and forwarding agent, containerisation, pipeline; courier and registered post, postal order; unit trust, bank draft, overdraft, collateral; WTO, ECOWAS free movement, customs union; life assurance beyond indemnity, average clause N24,000, no-claim bonus, reinsurance, compulsory third party; trade association, chamber of commerce, social responsibility, retained earnings. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-5, NECO Commerce (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
